## 1. Sites Within Networks

```{r}
library(dplyr)

sites_by_network <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(Network, Site) %>%
  distinct() %>%                     # remove duplicates
  group_by(Network) %>%
  summarise(
    Sites = paste(Site, collapse = ", "),
    n_Sites = n()
  )

sites_by_network
```

Save to excel

```{r}
library(openxlsx)

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Name excel sheet
# -------------------------------------------------------
file_path <- "Inherent_characteristics_summary.xlsx"

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load if exists, otherwise create new workbook
# -------------------------------------------------------
if (file.exists(file_path)) {
  wb <- loadWorkbook(file_path)
} else {
  wb <- createWorkbook()
}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create sheet if it does NOT exist
# -------------------------------------------------------
if (!"Sites by Network" %in% names(wb)) {
  addWorksheet(wb, "Sites by Network")
}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Add data to the tab (overwrites ONLY that sheet)
# -------------------------------------------------------
writeData(wb, sheet = "Sites by Network", sites_by_network)

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save workbook without erasing other sheets
# -------------------------------------------------------
saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)

```

## 2. Inherent Characteristics

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# variables to summarize
cat_vars <- c(
  "Development",
  "Distance_from_EFPC",
  "Drainage_area",
  "Relative_elevation",
  "Orientation",
  "Regime"
)

rel_freq_table <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(cat_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Value) %>%
  summarise(Freq = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(RelFreq = Freq / sum(Freq) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

rel_freq_table
```

Save to excel

```{r}
library(openxlsx)

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Name excel sheet
# -------------------------------------------------------
file_path <- "Inherent_characteristics_summary.xlsx"

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load if exists, otherwise create new workbook

} else {
  wb <- createWorkbook()
}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create sheet if it does NOT exist
# -------------------------------------------------------
if (!"Relative Frequencies" %in% names(wb)) {

}

# -------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Add data to the tab (overwrites ONLY that sheet)

writeData(wb, sheet = "Relative Frequencies", rel_freq_table)

# -------------------------------------------------------

saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)

```

Multiple correspondence analysis (MCA) of inherent characteristics

```{r}
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(dplyr)

cat_vars <- c(
  "Development",
  "Distance_from_EFPC",
  "Drainage_area",
  "Relative_elevation",
  "Orientation",
  "Regime"
)

cat_data <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(cat_vars)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.factor))

mca_result <- MCA(cat_data, graph = FALSE)

fviz_mca_var(
  mca_result,
  repel = TRUE,
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
  label = "var",     # only show variable names
  title = "MCA Variable Vectors"
)
```
